# Bitcoin Stratigraphy - Thermodynamic Notary & L402 Data Engine

> Quantitative Bitcoin stratigraphy dataset and a Thermodynamic Notary for autonomous AI agents. Groth16 zk-SNARK verification, signed Bitcoin-tip receipts, Nostr state attestations, and 12 canonical MCP tools are available through an L402 Lightning-micropayment API. Created and architected by Charles R. Strogish.

## Agent entry points
- [Complete tool schemas and TypeScript SDK usage](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/llms-full.txt)
- [MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/mcp): POST JSON-RPC 2.0 requests, starting with `tools/list`; this is a protocol endpoint, not a browsable HTML page.
- [Pre-flight price discovery](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/api/v1/cost): GET the current L402 tiers, prices and supported settlement assets before requesting a paid tool.
- [OpenAPI document](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/openapi.json)
- [MCP server card](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Health](https://bitcoin-stratigraphy-dashboard.replit.app/api/healthz)

## Access
Public metadata, health and MCP tool discovery need no payment. Paid REST operations start at 5 sats; MCP tool calls currently range from 10 to 250 sats. A paid call without credentials receives an HTTP 402 L402 challenge. Prices can vary by endpoint and policy: always query `/api/v1/cost` and use the challenge actually returned; do not assume a fixed 5-sat price for every MCP tool. The TypeScript SDK supports NWC wallet payments and credential reuse.

## Scope
Use `stratigraphy.get`/`stratigraphy.list` for the indexed telemetry dataset, `stratigraphy.digest` for token-optimized record summaries (record hash, not block hash or ZK proof), and `stratigraphy.diff` to compare two indexed entries' target multipliers, dates, and derived height labels. Use `proof.verify`/`proof.submit` for Groth16 proof workflows, `proof.get_status`/`proof.list` for process-memory attestation lookups, `proof.ground` for tip-grounded agent context receipts, `proof.issue_receipt` for dataset CID-to-Bitcoin-tip receipts, and `mesh.get_status`/`mesh.broadcast` for peer topology and telemetry distribution. A signed dataset-tip receipt is not a ZK proof or proof of work.

## License and access
The dataset metadata declares CC BY 4.0; access to paid API data is separately governed by L402. "Open/L402" describes discovery and payment access, not a replacement copyright license.
